contract.atomicFactSet: `LibraCandidateAcceptedMessage@1` + current open Candidate Delivery/Reservation CAS + exact Candidate member set + Procurement Inbox dedup；同事务把Delivery置`accepted`、全部对应`proc_run_materials candidate_delivery → transferred+handoff_accepted`并冻结同一Receipt Evidence；Material Control已经由Handoff A Accepted转移，本事务不得再次转移或释放；重复消息返回同一closure result，已rejected或Evidence不一致稳定拒绝
contract.rollbackInvariant: Any participant, revision fence, digest, or CAS failure leaves zero transaction writes visible; no commit marker, receipt, or outbox may survive alone.

crashFixtures.faultInjectionPoints: Inbox写入前后、open Delivery CAS前后、Reservation逐项转移中途、Delivery terminal与Inbox result提交前后、迟到Rejected消息
crashFixtures.requiredInvariant: Delivery、全部Candidate member transferred+handoff_accepted、同一Receipt Evidence与Inbox result全有或全无；Material Control不变；重复消息重放同一closure digest，相反终态或digest冲突稳定拒绝
